text:
Ps: this is my Chief of Staff, Jarvis. He is the Coordinator and keeps up the constraints in the partner bots.
https://x.ai/bot/vGBwBEELW79gSF340zJpb

Atm I still keep the lid on many things and control all in- and outgoing communication. 
Cerberus is a security bot helping with that (Auditing)
Sally is my salesassistant
Sissy is my System Admin
Hermes is my news and Trends bot
Orvis is my Office bot and in charge of communication with third party
Fabian deals with family things, like checking for events in the area

A very restrained approach, but I like to hold the reigns...
